Team: Reports into US-based Engineering Team

Employment Type: Full-time

Position Overview

  • We are seeking a highly capable Full Stack Software Engineer to build and maintain scalable, high-quality web applications using NodeJS, React, and TypeScript.
  • This role works closely with a US-based engineering team, along with design and QA, to deliver customer-facing features with a strong emphasis on quality, performance, and maintainability.
  • Our platform includes spatial data and mapping workflows, so candidates with GIS or geospatial experience are a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain full stack features using NodeJS, React, and TypeScript
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs with a focus on performance and reliability
  • Implement responsive, accessible UI components with high fidelity to product designs and UX standards
  • Collaborate with Product and Technical Product Managers to clarify requirements and edge cases

Backend & API Development

  • Develop scalable backend services using NodeJS
  • Design and maintain data models, business logic, and API contracts
  • Ensure security, performance, and reliability across backend services
  • Write unit and integration tests to validate backend functionality

Frontend Development

  • Build modern React applications using TypeScript and best practices (hooks, state management, component architecture)
  • Translate designs into high-quality, high-fidelity user interfaces
  • Optimize frontend performance and ensure cross-browser compatibility

Engineering Excellence

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared engineering standards
  • Collaborate with QA on test planning, bug fixes, and release readiness
  • Identify and reduce technical debt while improving system reliability

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work effectively with a distributed US-based team through clear documentation and async communication
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and risks clearly via Jira and team channels

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
  • Proven experience developing with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or agentic workflows) and getting real leverage from them without sacrificing code quality
  • Strong experience with NodeJS, React, and TypeScript in production environments
  • Experience building and consuming APIs (REST preferred; GraphQL a plus)
  • Proficiency with modern frontend tooling and build systems
  • Solid understanding of relational (SQL/PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and Jira
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

AI / LLM

  • Experience building or integrating AI/LLM features into product, including API integration, prompt design, and reliably handling model outputs
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts relevant to software engineering: embeddings, vector search, RAG, function calling, and evaluation strategies
  • Familiarity with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
  • Experience fine-tuning, evaluating, or deploying ML models in production

GIS / Geospatial

  • Experience working with spatial data, maps, or geolocation services
  • Familiarity with tools such as PostGIS, ESRI, GeoJSON, Mapbox, Leaflet, or similar

Infrastructure & Practices

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or similar)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Understanding of performance optimization and security best practices

Working Hours & Flexibility

  • This role requires a 3-4 hour daily overlap with US Eastern Time. In practice, this means availability through roughly the late evening IST (e.g., until ~10:00 PM IST / 12:30 PM ET). The candidate should be comfortable with occasional early-morning or late-evening meetings to support cross-team collaboration.

Success Metrics

  • High-quality features delivered on time and aligned with acceptance criteria
  • Low defect rates and minimal rework during QA and UAT
  • Positive feedback from Engineering, Product, Design, and QA teams on collaboration
  • Well-tested, maintainable code across frontend and backend
  • Consistent contribution to sprint goals and team initiatives

ABOUT THE ROLE


The Simulation / DES squad builds the discrete-event simulator that validates warehouse designs before a single physical bot is deployed bot movement, throughput, bottlenecks, deadlocks all made visible through a rich, interactive front end. As a Frontend Engineer on this team you own the visual layer of the simulator: the replay player, congestion heatmaps, scenario builder and the metrics dashboard that help solutions engineers understand a warehouse at a glance. You will work directly with the simulation engine team to design the data contracts your UI consumes, and you will raise the bar for what a simulation front end can feel like in an industrial B2B product.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


  • Build the replay & visualisation surface — Implement a frame-accurate replay player that renders bot trajectories, queue depths and flow states over time using Canvas 2D or WebGL.
  • Own heatmaps and spatial analytics — Build congestion, throughput and deadlock heatmaps on top of a grid representation of the warehouse map; ensure they update in real time during live simulation runs.
  • Build the scenario-configuration UI — Design and implement the parameterised scenario builder (stations, bots, highways, storage zones) that feeds the headless simulation engine.
  • Design and consume simulation data contracts — Work with backend engineers to define efficient event-stream formats (WebSocket / SSE) and local state models that keep the UI responsive at high event rates.
  • Build the metrics dashboard — Implement time-series charts (throughput, cycle time, bot utilisation, queue depth) with filtering, zoom and export.
  • Maintain performance and correctness — Profile and optimise rendering at scale: 1,000+ simultaneous bots, dense event streams, smooth 60 fps playback.
  • Write tests and own quality — Unit-test rendering logic, write visual-regression tests; own the definition-of-done for every feature you ship.
  • Instrument your surfaces — Add product-analytics events (e.g. Mixpanel) for feature adoption and funnel analysis; add Grafana-linked error observability.

MINIMUM (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS


  • 4–8 years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in React (hooks, context, custom hooks) and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Canvas 2D or WebGL for data-driven rendering.
  • Experience building data-heavy or analytics-heavy UIs (charts, grids, maps).
  • Familiarity with WebSocket or Server-Sent Events for real-time data.
  • Solid understanding of browser performance: layout, paint, compositing, memory.
  • Experience with state management (Zustand, Jotai, Redux, or similar).
  • Comfortable working in a CI/CD environment (GitHub Actions, trunk-based development).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • Experience working on simulation, game, mapping or geospatial visualisation products.
  • Familiarity with D3.js or similar data-visualisation libraries.
  • Exposure to warehousing, logistics or robotics domain.
  • Experience consuming and designing REST / gRPC APIs from the frontend.
  • Contributed to a design system or shared component library.
  • Exposure to feature-flag driven development (gradual rollouts, A/B experiments).
  • Worked in a Spotify-style squad or cross-functional product team.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS


We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.


  • Core stack: React 18+, TypeScript, Vite / Webpack.
  • Rendering: Canvas 2D API, WebGL (raw or via Three.js / PixiJS); understanding of GPU pipeline stages.
  • Real-time data: WebSocket, SSE, client-side event buffering and replay.
  • State: Zustand / Jotai preferred; context + reducers acceptable.
  • Testing: Vitest / Jest for unit tests; Playwright or Cypress for E2E; Storybook for component isolation.
  • Observability: instruments features with analytics events; reads Grafana dashboards for error rates.
  • Tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions CI, GCP-hosted APIs, Backstage for service discovery.
  • Code quality: ESLint, Prettier, strict TypeScript; respects CODEOWNERS review process.
  • Performance: uses Chrome DevTools / React Profiler to identify and fix rendering bottlenecks.

HOW WE WORK


You work in the Simulation / DES squad, a small cross-functional team that owns the DES mission end-to-end. The squad is IC-led — a Staff Engineer sets technical direction; there is no engineering manager layer. You own your surfaces from design through production, including on-call for the frontend services you build. You are expected to work autonomously on feature-sized tasks, surface blockers early, and help define the definition-of-done for anything you ship.

The Data technology team within MSCI is responsible for providing data products to different product lines of MSCI. We are looking for strong technology professional with exceptional analytical skills to be part of a talented software development team in Mumbai. The selected candidate will have a unique opportunity to design, build and maintain state of the art data management solutions for the world's leading provider of investment decision support tools to investment community across the globe.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a bright and dynamic engineer, motivated and able to work independently as well as work in partnership with IT and Business teams spread across the globe. The candidate needs to be a strong UI programmer.\nBesides technical skills, we are looking for a candidate with a strong sense of ownership and with ability to work in a diverse team.

Qualifications

At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UI Programming

  • Expert in TypeScript, React JS, Redux and Micro-front end.
  • Exemplary design and problem-solving skills, with a proven track record of engineering excellence at scale.
  • Expert in modern CSS/SASS
  • Working experience in Python
  • Working knowledge in Azure Devops, build pipeline and deployments.
  • Hands -on experience in automated testing using playwright or other framework.
  • Experience in pixel perfect UI and UX design.
  • Knowledge of web-accessibility best-practices
  • Knowledge of front-end security best-practices
  • Strong understanding of the HTTP protocol
  • Strong written communication skill.

 

What we offer you

  • Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
  • Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
  • A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
  • A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
  • Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
  • Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
  • We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. Designation: Programmer Analyst Fullstack (Spring Boot, React.js)
Experience: 3+ years in fullstack development
Role Type: Full-time | Permanent

About the Job


IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security.


Join our dynamic development team as a Fullstack Programmer Analyst, where you will design and deliver secure, scalable applications that power our cloud services. This role is ideal for developers with hands-on experience in both frontend and backend technologies, particularly React.js and Spring Boot. It suits those who are passionate about building high-performance web applications from end to end.

What you will be doing:


Frontend development


  • Build and maintain responsive, modular user interfaces using React.js, AngularJS, and RxJS.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement intuitive, user-friendly designs.
  • Integrate frontend components with RESTful APIs and backend services.

Backend development


  • Design and develop REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot.
  • Manage data access and storage using MySQL and optimize queries for performance
  • Ensure backend systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.

Collaboration & code quality


  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including QA, designers, and other developers.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to the best practices in software design and testing.
  • Debug and resolve issues across the stack to ensure application reliability.

What we expect from you:


  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in fullstack development.
  • Proficiency in React.js and AngularJs for frontend development.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot for building scalable backend services.
  • Working knowledge of MySQL or other relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of web application architecture and frontend-backend integration.
  • Ability to write clean, well-structured code and follow industry best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.
  • A BE/BTech/MTech in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics, or a related field from a recognized university.

Good to have:


  • Experience with Microservices architecture, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Logstash, or Kibana.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and performance tools in a production environment.

Why join us?


At IDrive, we're creating an environment where innovation thrives, talent is recognized, and people are empowered to grow. We are committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally.


Here's what you can look forward to as part of our team:


Work & life balance


  • Hybrid work model with flexible hours to suit your lifestyle
  • Paid time off and holidays to relax and recharge
  • Parental leave for lifes important milestones

Health & wellness


  • Medical insurance with customizable coverage for you and your family
  • Comprehensive life and accidental insurance for added peace of mind

Culture & community


  • Company events and team lunches to foster connection and collaboration
  • Festival gifts and goodies to celebrate special occasions together

Perks that matter


  • Competitive pay that reflects your experience and contributions
  • Online storage space

About the Role
We are looking for a highly energetic, creative, and execution-focused UI/UX & Full Stack App Developer to build and enhance our web and mobile applications from concept to launch. You will work directly with the founders to transform ideas into intuitive, high-quality digital products.
This is a startup role requiring someone who enjoys building products from scratch, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and takes complete ownership of delivering exceptional user experiences.
Key Responsibilities
Product Design & User Experience

  • Design intuitive, user-centric interfaces for web and mobile applications.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Ensure a seamless and consistent user experience across devices.
  • Conduct usability testing and continuously improve the product experience.

Frontend Development

  • Build responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Develop reusable UI components and maintain a scalable design system.
  • Optimize applications for performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across browsers and devices.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to integrate APIs and deliver end-to-end features.

Mobile App Development

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications (Android and iOS).
  • Ensure smooth performance, usability, and compatibility across devices.
  • Publish and maintain applications on app stores when required.

Backend & Integration

  • Develop REST APIs and backend services.
  • Design and manage databases.
  • Integrate third-party APIs, authentication, payment gateways, and AI services.
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

Product Ownership

  • Work closely with founders to understand business goals and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Participate in product planning, sprint execution, and feature prioritization.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve product quality and user engagement.

Required Skills
UI/UX

  • Figma
  • Adobe XD (preferred)
  • Wireframing & Prototyping
  • User Journey Mapping
  • Design Systems
  • Responsive Design
  • Mobile-First Design

Frontend

  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • JavaScript (ES6+)
  • TypeScript
  • React.js / Next.js
  • Tailwind CSS / Material UI

Mobile

  • React Native or Flutter
  • Android & iOS application development
  • App Store and Play Store deployment

Backend

  • Node.js
  • Express.js
  • REST APIs
  • PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB

Cloud & Tools

  • Git/GitHub
  • AWS fundamentals
  • Docker (preferred)
  • CI/CD basics

AI & Modern Development

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT)
  • Ability to integrate AI APIs into applications is an advantage

What Were Looking For

  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience building web and mobile applications.
  • Strong UI/UX design sense with attention to detail.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Startup mindset with the ability to work independently.
  • Passion for building products that users love.
  • Quick learner who adapts to new technologies rapidly.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Portfolio showcasing web and mobile applications.
  • GitHub profile with personal or open-source projects.
  • Experience working in SaaS, startup, or product-based companies.
  • Familiarity with Agile development practices.

Success Measures

  • Deliver high-quality product features on schedule.
  • Build intuitive, engaging user experiences.
  • Maintain high application performance and reliability.
  • Contribute innovative ideas that improve the product.
  • Collaborate effectively with founders and cross-functional teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and self-driven builder who combines UI/UX creativity with strong full-stack engineering skills. The ideal candidate is passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences, embraces challenges, and is excited to build and scale a product from the ground up in a fast-paced startup environment.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Java Full Stack Developer (2+ years) to join their team. In this full-time, on-site role located in Bangalore, Karnataka, you will be responsible for both backend and frontend development, contributing to the design and implementation of robust applications that meet business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot).
  • Implement frontend solutions using React.js to create dynamic user interfaces.
  • Design and develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs for seamless data interaction.
  • Work with databases such as MongoDB and PostgreSQL/MySQL for data storage and retrieval.
  • Utilize event-driven architecture with Apache Kafka to enhance application performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain best practices in software development.
  • Manage version control using Git and implement CI/CD practices for efficient deployment.

Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Java backend development, specifically with Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in frontend development using React.js.
  • Experience in API development, both RESTful and GraphQL.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MongoDB and PostgreSQL/MySQL.
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture, particularly with Apache Kafka.
  • Strong knowledge of Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of professional experience in full stack development.
  • Demonstrated experience in building and deploying production-grade applications.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Front-End Developer (React.js) with 3 to 5 years of experience in building modern, responsive, and high-performance web applications. AI Experience (Mandatory)

  • Code generation and refactoring
  • Debugging and troubleshooting
  • Unit test generation
  • Documentation
  • Improving development productivity and code quality

Good to Have

  • Next.js

  • Jest / React Testing Library
  • Azure or AWS
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Basic exposure to LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Passion for modern frontend technologies and continuous learning

Are you passionate about developing mission-critical, high quality software solutions, using cutting-edge technology, in a dynamic environment

OUR IMPACT

We are Compliance Engineering, a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems.

We:

  • build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm.
  • have access to the latest technology and to massive amounts of structured and unstructured data.
  • leverage modern frameworks to build responsive and intuitive front end and Big Data applications.

HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL

As a member of our team, you will:

  • partner globally with sponsors, users and engineering colleagues across multiple divisions to create end-to-end solutions,
  • learn from experts
  • leverage various technologies depending on the team including Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, APIs, GraphQL, Elastic Search, Kafka, Kubernetes
  • be able to innovate and incubate new ideas
  • have an opportunity to work on a broad range of problems, often dealing with large data sets, including real-time processing, messaging, workflow and UI/UX
  • be involved in the full life cycle; defining, designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software across our products.

AI Assisted Engineering & Productivity

In addition, you will:

  • Effectively use AI assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude Code, or equivalent) to improve developer productivity and reduce development cycle time.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate:
    • code generation and refactoring,
    • test creation and coverage improvement,
    • debugging, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
  • Use AI assisted reasoning to understand complex codebases, rapidly prototype solutions, and improve code quality while maintaining strong engineering standards.
  • Partner with peers and reviewers to validate, harden, and productionize AI generated outputs, ensuring correctness, security, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Identify opportunities where AI tooling can reduce manual effort, minimize rework, and support faster, higher quality delivery to production.

QUALIFICATIONS

A successful candidate will possess the following attributes:

  1. A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar field of study.
  2. 2.5+ years professional software development experience
  3. Expertise in Java development.
  4. Experience in automated testing and SDLC concepts.
  5. The ability (and tenacity) to clearly express ideas and arguments in meetings and on paper.

Experience in some of the following is desired and can set you apart from other candidates:

  • Demonstrated experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI-assisted developer tools to enhance engineering productivity and accelerate software delivery.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI generated outputs and enhance them to production grade quality.
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and refine them to meet production-grade standards of quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Hands-on proficiency with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Devin to expedite code authoring, refactoring, and debugging across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Effective utilization of AI pair-programming tools to generate boilerplate code, unit tests, and technical documentation, enabling greater focus on architectural design and complex problem-solving.
  • Application of established prompt engineering best practices to elicit high-quality, context-aware code recommendations and reduce iteration cycles during development.
  • Practical integration of autonomous AI agents (e.g., Devin) for routine engineering tasks, including bug triage, dependency upgrades, and minor feature implementations, thereby freeing engineering bandwidth for higher-impact initiatives.
  • Adoption of AI-driven code review tools to proactively identify defects, security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks earlier in the development cycle, strengthening overall quality gates.
  • Experience with:
    • UI/UX development
    • API design, such as to create interconnected services
    • message buses or real time processing
    • relational databases
    • knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions
    • influencing and collaborating with stakeholders.

Job Description Full Stack AWS Developer


We are seeking a skilled Full Stack AWS Developer with expertise in Serverless architecture and cloud-native application development. In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS-based applications using modern backend and frontend technologies.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain AWS-based applications with a focus on Serverless architecture.
  • Develop backend services using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and TypeScript.
  • Design and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK.
  • Work with AWS services including RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL), DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, IAM, and S3.
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and document them using Swagger.
  • Develop and maintain frontend applications using React, Redux, TypeScript, CSS, and modern CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, Tailwind).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a platform-oriented architecture.
  • Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD.
  • Implement unit tests and support integration testing activities.
  • Contribute to multi-tenant SaaS application development and enhancements.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate with the team to build and integrate microservices-based systems and APIs.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following coding standards and best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–3 years of experience in software development.
  • Proven experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS.
  • Strong experience with:
  • TypeScript
  • AWS CDK
  • AWS Lambda
  • API Gateway
  • React
  • REST APIs
  • SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with Serverless CDK Framework is an advantage.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with multi-tenant web applications is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Good English communication skills

Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Java Full Stack Developer

Experience: 618 Years
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore
Job Type: Full-Time
Interview Process: Face-to-Face

Job Summary

We are looking for experienced Java Full Stack Developers with 618 years of experience to join our growing engineering team. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and modern front-end technologies, along with hands-on experience in cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and Agile development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications.
  • Build RESTful APIs and Microservices using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Develop responsive user interfaces using Angular or React.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and implement business requirements.
  • Participate in application architecture, design discussions, and code reviews.
  • Integrate applications with databases, messaging systems, and third-party services.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following best practices.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
  • Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Required Skills

  • 6–18 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (Java 8/11/17).
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA.
  • Strong knowledge of Microservices Architecture.
  • Experience in REST API development.
  • Front-end development using Angular (8+) or React.js.
  • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases like MongoDB is an advantage.
  • Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and Jenkins.
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Good understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of design patterns, OOP concepts, and data structures.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Redis or caching technologies.
  • Elasticsearch.
  • OAuth2, JWT, and Spring Security.
  • SonarQube, JUnit, Mockito.
